Meta CEO Zuckerberg Unveils Open-Source AI Vision

Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has outlined his company's vision for artificial intelligence, emphasizing an open-source approach. Meta has released a new AI model, Muse Glimmer 30B, designed for developers and capable of running on personal computers. Zuckerberg stated that AI will not eliminate jobs and predicted that small businesses will benefit from its integration. He also expressed a desire for "superintelligence for all" and suggested AI could be more intimate than existing assistants.
